title: phacelia palmeri var. foetida
intro: Phacelia palmeri var. foetida, commonly known as Stinking Phacelia or Palmer's Phacelia, is a perennial plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed to treat various health issues. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, its health benefits include supporting digestive health, reducing stress and anxiety, and providing relief from respiratory issues due to its expectorant and bronchodilator effects.
